info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Systems Assurance Management API
info.description: The Systems Assurance Management API offers tools for monitoring and evaluating the performance of IT systems within banking operations. It provides access to critical information related to system health and compliance, helping businesses ensure operational reliability and mitigate risks. This API is essential for IT managers and system administrators in the banking sector, enabling them to efficiently retrieve system assurance metrics. Use cases include assessing compliance with regulatory standards and identifying potential system enhancements.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific systems assurance resource.
get.description: This operation allows developers to fetch comprehensive details for the systems assurance resource identified by the given ID (RES-100045). It provides all relevant information necessary for further actions or assessments related to this resource.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving systems assurance details for the specified resource ID. The body should adhere to the schema defined for the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested data.

GetSystemsAssuranceByIdRequest.description: A request body template for the REST operation that specifies parameters in application/json format.
